shop.title: Shop
shop.empty: No products to show yet. New pieces are on their way.

product.hiddenNote: Visitors don’t see this product until you show it in the admin.
product.full: Your cart cannot hold more of this product.

cart.title: Cart
cart.noscript: The cart needs JavaScript to count your items and work out the shipping.
cart.announce: Your cart now holds {count} item | Your cart now holds {count} items
cart.empty: Your cart is empty. The products you add in the shop wait for you here.

issues.title: Your cart changed
issues.unnamed: {count} product no longer sold | {count} products no longer sold

failure.other: The cart could not be updated. Check your connection, then try again.
failure.tooMany: Too many updates in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.

summary.title: Summary
summary.chooseFirst: Choose the delivery country to see the shipping.
summary.undeliverable: The shop does not deliver to this country for now. Choose another one.
summary.nowhere: The shop does not deliver yet.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions, commissions or simply a hello: the studio reads every message.
contact.noscript: The form needs JavaScript. You can reach the studio through the links on this page.

form.title: Write to the studio
form.name: Your name
form.emailHint: The studio answers at this address.

sent.title: Message sent
sent.text: Thank you. The studio will answer at {email}.

failure.tooMany: Too many messages were sent from this connection. Try again later: what you wrote is still here.
failure.closed: The form is closed for now. Reach the studio through the links on this page.
failure.other: The message could not be sent. Check your connection and try again: what you wrote is still here.

form.lineBreak: Write it on a single line.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist, or no longer does.

draft.title: Draft
draft.text: Only admins see this page. Texts, links, images and legal pages wait for “Publish”; products, conventions and shipping are already live.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.empty: No convention is planned for now. Follow the studio to hear about the next one.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.noscript: The checkout needs JavaScript to work out the total and open the payment.
checkout.emailHint: The confirmation and the shipping news go to this address.
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.phoneHint: Only given to the carrier if the parcel needs it.
checkout.terms: I have read and accept the {terms}.
checkout.termsMissing: The payment opens once the terms of sale have a text.
checkout.payNote: You pay on the secure page of SumUp, then come back here to follow your order.

errors.terms: Accept the terms of sale to order.

failure.outdated: The total is now {amount}. Check the summary, then pay again.
failure.payment: The payment page could not be opened. Nothing was charged: try again in a moment.
failure.tooMany: Too many attempts from this connection. Try again in a few minutes: what you typed is still here.

placed.title: An order is waiting for its payment
placed.text: Nothing is charged until you pay on SumUp. Pay again below to place a new order.

pending.title: Payment not confirmed yet
pending.text: If you paid on SumUp, the confirmation arrives in a moment, followed by an email. If you have not paid, nothing has been charged.

stalled.title: Still waiting for the confirmation
stalled.text: The confirmation is taking longer than usual. If you paid, an email will follow: reload this page in a few minutes.

paid.title: Thank you for your order
paid.text: The payment is confirmed and a confirmation email is on its way. The studio packs your order by hand and writes to you when it ships.

failed.title: The payment did not go through
failed.text: Nothing was charged. Your cart is kept: go back to it to try again.

expired.title: The time to pay ran out
expired.text: Nothing was charged. Your cart is kept: go back to it to order again.

shipped.title: Your order is on its way
shipped.text: The studio has sent your parcel.

cancelled.title: This order is cancelled
cancelled.text: Write to the studio if you have a question about it.
